# Xahau URIToken fixtures: findings

Recorded 2026-10-26 from `wss://xahau.network` (xahaud 2026.10.13-release+4119, network id 21337), in three runs: 9 ledgers, 10 transactions, the cases of `manifest.json` (`uritoken_remint` also names its burn). Every fact says how it was checked, with throwaway scripts (not in the repository) on the recorded ledgers and on the node.

## Where the cases came from

Almost all URIToken traffic is Evernode lease tokens. A throwaway script walked validated ledgers back from 26777346 (2026-10-25) to 26727347 (49,999 ledgers); ledgers of more than 60 transactions (17,072, the Evernode bursts) were counted from their hashes only, because the node throttles at 10,000,000 units per hour; the other 32,927 were read. It saw 24,474 `URITokenBuy`, 15,430 `URITokenCreateSellOffer`, 14,211 `URITokenMint`, 13,857 `URITokenBurn`, 251 `Remit` with URIToken nodes, 4 `SetRemarks` that touch a URIToken, and no `URITokenCancelSellOffer`. `account_tx` on the non-Evernode marketplace `r9gvUQxtV98nRAM26aknj4h6RXKyXCLMVS` (tokens issued by `rodinGM9xiKq7rDDnLPyieREkqGJ6zKyb`) and four other accounts found the cancel and the Remits.

## Facts

1. The first ledger (checked 2026-10-26 15:02 UTC with `server_info`, `ledger` and `ledger_entry`): `complete_ledgers` of `https://xahau.network` starts at 1 (`1-26811284`; the same start on 2026-10-25, `1-26777330`). Ledger 1 has `close_time` 0, a zero `parent_hash` and hash `AEDC861F60683C91EB9D517A40D207F37B4F07E5141358DAE1ED3D8195728094`; ledger 2 closed 751983660 = 2023-10-30T12:21:00Z, hash `1E01D0D17E39211FA6683F1F8DD29AB1447698408A920137817032A3BF4D6C17`. `URIToken` (`ECF412BE0964EC2E71DCF807EEEA6EA8470D3DB15173D46F28AB6E234860AC32`) is in the `Amendments` object of ledger 1 (`ledger_entry` index `7DB0788C020F02780A673DC74757F23823FA3014C1866E72CC4CD8B226CD6EF4`, 37 amendments). Decision 18 holds: enabled at ledger 1, date 2023-10-30.
2. The `URITokenBuy` price is the transaction's `Amount`, paid to the seller. `uritoken_buy_above_ask` (ledger 26763778): `Amount` 4200000000 drops, equal to the entry's `PreviousFields.Amount`; the seller `r9gvUQxtV98nRAM26aknj4h6RXKyXCLMVS` gained exactly 4200000000, the buyer lost 4200026810 (price and the fee of 26810). An Evernode buy (ledger 26775071, `E2805F40…`, not recorded) in EVR: the buyer's trust line fell by 0.017 and the seller's rose by 0.017. No buy paid more than the ask in any of the 24,474 seen or the 150 in the account histories, so the case is a buy at exactly the ask.
3. `Remit` moves a URIToken and clears its offer in one step (`remit_transfer`, ledger 26771798): the entry's `PreviousFields` hold `Amount` (3350000000) and `Owner` (sender `r9gvUQxtV98nRAM26aknj4h6RXKyXCLMVS`); `FinalFields.Owner` is the destination `rAucmWmE8yiueemhmrGh5MyD2mNjXfpQp` and has no `Amount`. `Remit` with `MintURIToken` (`remit_mint`, ledger 26689211) creates an entry with `Issuer` the sender `rodinGM9xiKq7rDDnLPyieREkqGJ6zKyb`, `Owner` the destination `r9gvUQxtV98nRAM26aknj4h6RXKyXCLMVS`, a `Digest` and the `URI`, no `Flags`; the destination's balance rose by 200000 drops and the sender's fell by 229607 (fee 29607 and the same 200000).
4. Metadata shapes: a sell offer created on an entry is a ModifiedNode whose `PreviousFields` is empty (an added field is not listed); a cancel, a buy and a Remit list the removed `Amount` in `PreviousFields` (a buy also `Owner` and `OwnerNode`). A mint sets the entry's `Flags` to the transaction's (1); `Issuer` and `Owner` are the sender. `Digest` is optional (Rodin's tokens have one, Evernode's not). A burn of a token with a standing offer keeps `Amount` in the deleted node's `FinalFields` (`uritoken_burn_with_offer`: 0.0001 EVR). A `SetRemarks` that touches a URIToken changes neither `Owner` nor `Amount`.
5. Burn and re-mint of one id (decision 19) happens: 4 pairs in the scan, all Evernode lease tokens. The recorded one: `E5ECD96D609E8E7C29C967D3D2FA542AE58FC9A05B9C4EAE7BFF608A7D0306A2`, burned by `r4k1jdyThSDbPwbNrpiuqNCoRJ61y9N4Wj` in ledger 26763618 and minted again by the same account, with the same URI and Flags 1, in ledger 26763629 (11 ledgers later): the same index.
6. Evernode traffic comes in bursts of 150 to 200 transactions per ledger: mint, sell offer in EVR, buy at the ask, burn. A rate-limited node answers `slowDown` / `tooBusy` with "retry in ~N ms".

## Not found

- `uritoken_mint_with_offer`: none of the 14,211 `URITokenMint` seen in the 32,927 ledgers read, nor the mints in the `account_tx` of five marketplace accounts, carries an `Amount` or a `Destination` (64 `URITokenCreateSellOffer` do carry a `Destination`). Task 5 needs a `synthetic-…` transaction.
